files.content: # Shadow puppets — Style Prompt > Dyed, translucent hide puppets carved like lace, pressed against a lamp-lit cotton screen: colour that arrives as light through the leather, holes that glow, overlaps that go darker, hands that tremble, and a storyteller's placard below. ## 1. Essence, and what it is not A bright cloth screen, warm in the middle and browner at the edges. Flat puppets and scenery cut from **translucent dyed hide** stand on it, lit from behind by an oil lamp. Colour arrives *by transmitted light*: dyes glow like stained glass, carved holes show the brightest cloth, and where two pieces overlap the light goes darker by itself. Puppets are jointed with visible **rivets** (a dark ring and a pale knot) and moved on rods, so they **tremble in the hand**, loose parts swing, and the whole screen **flickers with the lamp**. It is live theatre, not stop-motion and not a black silhouette film: colour is the second protagonist. Not paper-cut (the light comes *through*), not stained glass (no lead lines, pieces move and overlap), not flat vector cut-out. ## 2. Materials & rendering - **Transmission model.** Cloth first, then every piece drawn on it with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` inside an isolated group. Holes (alpha 0) leave the bare cloth, so they are always the brightest value; overlaps multiply and darken with no extra work. - **Hide.** Each piece is painted on a canvas once (seeded), a tileable hide texture (mottling, fibres, a few dark specks) is multiplied into it, and the piece's own alpha is restored with `destination-in` so holes survive. Then it becomes an `` and only moves. - **Carving is density.** Leave thin strips, cut away most of the area: crescent rows (scales), diamond lattice, coin holes (round hole, square of hide inside), cloud scrolls, parallel arc slits (water), strata along a ridge, leaf holes in a canopy. A dark outline of 1.5-2.4 px around every region. With `destination-out`, set `fillStyle` to opaque black first. - **Cloth.** A warm radial lobe, fine crossing weave lines (a static layer, multiplied on top of everything), a bright warm-white lamp centre falling off to a brown vignette (one static radial layer, never grey), scattered small carved suns over the top of the cloth. - **Figures** are jointed puppets in profile: body and head as one piece, legs separate on rivets, an open-cut face (thin strips around a hole) for a sympathetic figure and a solid one for an antagonist, a back cloth in the brand dye. **Scenery** is carved set pieces on mostly empty cloth, one lace piece per element, a narrow carved ground strip, a separate strip for water. - **Titles are plaques**: dark hide with a carved border (coin holes, scroll corners); the letters glow because they are cut through it. ## 3. Colour logic - `--latar` is the cloth: the screen takes a pale mix of it with a fixed paper white (`--kain`), so even a dark brand keeps a lit screen and pieces keep reading. - `--utama` is the main dye: the moon disc and the puppet's back cloth, plus the stamp on the placard (`--teks-di-utama` on it). `--aksen` is the second dye: the moon's rays, the tail tuft, the number discs (`--teks-di-aksen` on them). - Fixed, not brand: hide (`--kulit`, `--kulit-2`), ink for outlines, green and indigo dyes (`--hijau`, `--biru`), dark brown wood, lacquer for plaques and the placard, gold for the placard line, the paper white. Everything leans warm: nothing is brighter than the lamp. - Thin things that must read are dark; pale pieces vanish on a bright cloth. Overlap is darkness: plan which pieces cross. - Night is fewer lamps, never added blue. ## 4. Type - `--font-judul`: Playfair Display 700. Plaque titles at about 78 px (1920 wide), letter-spacing 0.06em, in cloth-light on dark hide with a faint warm glow. Number discs 44 px. - `--font-isi`: Cormorant Garamond (500 italic for plaque sub-lines at 36 px, 700 for the placard at 44 px). A narrow lacquer **placard** low on the screen, a thin gold inner line, a square stamp in `--utama` at its left carrying one letter; cream on dark; slide in 14 px over 0.3 s, hold at least 1.8 s or speech plus 0.6 s. - Text on the cloth itself is avoided: put it on plaques or the placard, which are fixed dark, so it reads under any brand. ## 5. Motion quality - **Tremor on every puppet**: 5 px and 4 px of low-frequency value noise (about 3 Hz) and 0.02 rad of rotation; plaques at 60%. The lamp flickers 14% at about 7 Hz plus a fast 31 rad/s sine of 4%. - **Press on / lift off**: arrivals come 1.35× large and blurred (14 px) onto the cloth and snap sharp in 0.5 s (`power3.out`); exits grow to 1.3×, blur 10 px and fade in 0.7 s (`power2.in`). Blur only on these few small elements. - **Hops**: two sequential tweens, rise `power2.out` and fall `power2.in` (apex 100-120 px for a crossing, 26 px for a walking step), legs swing ±33° in the air and return on landing. Freeze on each landing about 0.25 s while only the tremor runs; the landing piece dips 8 px (0.12 s yoyo). - Rising figures use `back.out(1.6)` over 0.7 s with 0.22 s stagger; numeral discs pop with `back.out(2.4)`. - The cloth and the cloth never moves on their own; the camera moves, nothing morphs: pieces rotate on rivets, slide, or are swapped. ## 6. Camera grammar | Move | Expresses | Can serve | |---|---|---| | Open straight on the lit cloth, small figure, slow push (1.0 to 1.04 over 3 s) | "This is a show" | a legend; a lesson; an episode start | | Hero grows to 55-60% of frame height (scale 1.5 to 2.8 over 0.9 s) | Being with one figure | a protagonist; a speaker; a product hero | | Slow lateral drift over a wide cloth (±20 px over 3 s) | Extent, a place laid out | a journey; a route; a procession | | **Push in and track** (scale 1.0 to 1.3 over 0.9 s, then drift ±288 px across the beat, then pull back wide in 1 s) | Being close to the action, then seeing the whole | counting; repetition; stages | | Follow a puppet, slight zoom | Being with one figure | a pursuit; a working day | | Medium-close, empty cloth between two pieces | Distance, hesitation | a choice; a parting | | Close on a carved detail | Craft as meaning | a vow; a tool; a clue | | Slow push of 2-3% on a still stage | The tale settles | an ending; an invitation | Puppets in profile; most of the cloth stays empty. Transitions are lamps dimming, a piece lifting off in light, a strip pressed on; never a generic crossfade or digital wipe. ## 7. Native moves - **The light is the world.** The cloth glows, carved holes are the brightest value, overlaps go dark. *Fits content like:* a night-market scene; a fever rising and falling; a lantern-lit lesson. - **Press on, lift off.** A piece arrives large and blurred and snaps sharp. *Fits content like:* an episode title; a rumour growing; a deadline pressing onto the cloth. - **Carved and translucent.** Holes glow, open faces versus solid ones. *Fits content like:* the good and bad characters of a fable; layers of a city; the parts of a machine. - **Hand-held.** Tremor and swinging parts everywhere. *Fits content like:* a nervous first time; a tightrope; a toddler's first steps. - **One hop, one count.** A figure crosses a row of pieces, a numbered disc pops at each landing. *Fits content like:* steps of a recipe; chapters of a course; days of a challenge. - **Strip lift-off.** A band of scenery pressed on or lifted to reveal another. *Fits content like:* before and after a flood; seasons; an old town under a new one. - **The storyteller's placard.** Narration on a lacquer board with a stamp. *Fits content like:* a bedtime-story episode; a museum guide; a podcast quote. ## 8. Pitfalls - Flat clip-art look: add the hide texture, denser openwork, deeper dyes and outlines everywhere. - Figures unreadable in profile: bigger head and ears, fuller lower body, a back cloth in a contrasting dye. - Radiating shapes read as saw blades: flame tongues with a fat base, a belly and a hooked tip, alternating curl. - Grey corners: vignette toward brown. - Creatures as one flat strip: each is its own puppet with hinged jaw, rod, patterned back; stagger and alternate facing. - Thin pale pieces vanish: make them dark; do not put brand-coloured text on the cloth. - Blur on large or many animated elements is slow: only the few plaques. - A pale or dark brand must keep the screen lit (the cloth is a mix, not the raw brand background).

# Shadow puppets: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 3, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: open on the lit cloth with small carved suns; a title plaque stands pressed on, a small hero walks in, the plaque lifts off
- id: buka di kain bercahaya dengan matahari kecil terpahat; plakat judul menempel, tokoh kecil berjalan masuk, plakat terangkat

## problem

- en: a carved strip is pressed onto the cloth and figures rise into view from behind it, one by one, tremor in every piece
- id: lajur terpahat ditekan ke kain dan sosok naik dari baliknya satu per satu, setiap potongan bergetar halus

## fact

- en: a carved detail pressed large and blurred onto the cloth, snapping sharp; the narrator's placard slides in below
- id: rincian terpahat ditekan besar dan buram ke kain lalu menajam; papan narator menyelip dari bawah

## step

- en: camera pushes in and tracks the hops: one hop, one count; each carved creature snaps its hinged jaw on landing, a number disc pops
- id: kamera mendekat mengikuti lompatan: satu lompatan satu hitungan; rahang berengsel tiap buaya menyentak saat didarati, cakram angka muncul

## compare

- en: two lit pieces side by side on the cloth, one lamp-bright, one overlapped and darker; a placard line under each
- id: dua potongan bercahaya berdampingan, satu terang lampu, satu bertumpuk dan lebih gelap; sebaris papan di bawah masing-masing

## number

- en: the figure carved as lit letters in a dark hide plaque, pressed on and held alone while the lamp breathes
- id: angka dipahat jadi huruf bercahaya di plakat kulit gelap, ditekan dan ditahan sendirian sementara lampu bernapas

## proof

- en: the finished stage locked: every piece in place, only tremor and lamp flicker; camera pulled back wide to rest
- id: panggung jadi terkunci: semua potongan di tempatnya, hanya tremor dan kedip lampu; kamera ditarik mundur lalu diam

## offer

- en: a big carved plaque pressed onto the cloth with the offer cut as glowing letters; the moon puppet stays behind it
- id: plakat besar terpahat ditekan ke kain dengan tawaran dipahat jadi huruf bercahaya; bulan wayang tetap di belakangnya

## cta

- en: the event plaque pressed on, contact cut as light; figures sink or rest, camera nearly still; held 2 s
- id: plakat acara ditekan, kontak dipahat jadi cahaya; sosok tenggelam atau diam, kamera nyaris diam; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: pull back from the cloth as pieces lift off one by one; the lamp and the last placard line stay lit; held 2 s
- id: kamera mundur dari kain saat potongan terangkat satu per satu; lampu dan baris papan terakhir tetap menyala; diam 2 detik

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id), mk = (t) => document.createElement(t), { sin, cos, PI, floor, hypot, min, max } = Math;
      const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v), lerp = (a, b, u) => a + (b - a) * u, ss = (u) => u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
      // PRNG berbiji dan derau 1D: sama di pratinjau dan render.
      const RNG = (seed) => { let s = (seed * 2654435761) >>> 0 || 1; return () => { s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = s; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; };
      const h1 = (i, s) => { const n = sin(i * 127.1 + s * 311.7) * 43758.5453; return n - floor(n); };
      const nz = (x, s = 0) => lerp(h1(floor(x), s), h1(floor(x) + 1, s), ss(x - floor(x)));
      // Token → warna kanvas lewat elemen uji.
      const probe = document.body.appendChild(mk("i"));
      const C = (n) => { probe.style.color = `var(--${n})`; return window["getComputed" + "Style"](probe).color; };

      // ===== 1. Kulit tembus cahaya (port carve.js): potongan = kanvas, lubang = alfa 0 =====
      const cv = (w, h) => Object.assign(mk("canvas"), { width: Math.ceil(w), height: Math.ceil(h) });
      function smooth(q, p) { const n = p.length, m = (i) => [(p[i % n][0] + p[(i + 1) % n][0]) / 2, (p[i % n][1] + p[(i + 1) % n][1]) / 2]; q.moveTo(...m(0)); for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) q.quadraticCurveTo(...p[i % n], ...m(i)); q.closePath(); }
      const poly = (q, p) => { p.forEach((a, i) => (i ? q.lineTo(...a) : q.moveTo(...a))); q.closePath(); };
      // Tekstur kulit: bercak rapat dan serat, dikali ke setiap potongan, lalu alfa asli mengembalikan lubang.
      let HIDE;
      function hide() {
        if (HIDE) return HIDE;
        const N = 256, c = cv(N, N), g = c.getContext("2d"), id = g.createImageData(N, N), w = (a, b, P, s) => h1((((a % P) + P) % P) * 9 + (((b % P) + P) % P), s);
        const vn = (x, y, P, s) => { const i = floor(x), j = floor(y), u = ss(x - i), v = ss(y - j); return lerp(lerp(w(i, j, P, s), w(i + 1, j, P, s), u), lerp(w(i, j + 1, P, s), w(i + 1, j + 1, P, s), u), v); };
        for (let y = 0; y < N; y++) for (let x = 0; x < N; x++) {
          const f = vn(x / 32, y / 32, 8, 1) * 0.5 + vn(x / 16, y / 16, 16, 2) * 0.3 + vn(x / 4, y / 4, 64, 3) * 0.2, v = (0.8 + 0.22 * f) * (h1(x, y) > 0.985 ? 0.8 : 1), i = (y * N + x) * 4;
          id.data.set([min(255, v * 255), min(255, v * 250), min(255, v * 238), 255], i);
        }
        g.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
        return (HIDE = c);
      }
      function piece(box, draw, K = 2, seed = 0) {
        const [x0, y0, x1, y1] = box, c = cv((x1 - x0) * K, (y1 - y0) * K), g = c.getContext("2d");
        g.setTransform(K, 0, 0, K, -x0 * K, -y0 * K); g.lineJoin = g.lineCap = "round";
        draw(g);
        const m = cv(c.width, c.height); m.getContext("2d").drawImage(c, 0, 0);
        g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        const pat = g.createPattern(hide(), "repeat"); pat.setTransform(new DOMMatrix([1, 0, 0, 1, (seed * 137) % 256, (seed * 71) % 256]));
        g.globalCompositeOperation = "multiply"; g.fillStyle = pat; g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-in"; g.drawImage(m, 0, 0);
        return { c, x0, y0, w: x1 - x0, h: y1 - y0 };
      }
      const fill = (g, col, fn, rule = "evenodd") => { g.beginPath(); fn(g); g.fillStyle = col; g.fill(rule); };
      const ink = (g, w, fn, col = C("tinta")) => { g.beginPath(); fn(g); g.strokeStyle = col; g.lineWidth = w; g.stroke(); };
      const cut = (g, fn, rule = "evenodd") => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out"; g.fillStyle = "black"; g.beginPath(); fn(g); g.fill(rule); g.restore(); };
      const cutLine = (g, w, fn) => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out"; g.strokeStyle = "black"; g.lineWidth = w; g.beginPath(); fn(g); g.stroke(); g.restore(); };
      const within = (g, fn, run) => { g.save(); g.beginPath(); fn(g); g.clip("evenodd"); run(); g.restore(); };
      // Ukiran: lubang bulan sabit (sisik), kisi belah ketupat, koin, gulungan awan, pita meander.
      const scales = (g, x0, y0, x1, y1, r) => cut(g, (q) => { for (let y = y0, k = 0; y < y1 + r; y += r * 0.95, k++) for (let x = x0 - r + (k % 2) * r; x < x1 + r; x += r * 2) { q.moveTo(x + cos(0.08 * PI) * r * 0.86, y + sin(0.08 * PI) * r * 0.86); q.arc(x, y, r * 0.86, 0.08 * PI, 0.92 * PI); q.arc(x, y - r * 0.18, r * 0.5, 0.88 * PI, 0.12 * PI, true); q.closePath(); } }, "nonzero");
      const lattice = (g, x0, y0, x1, y1, s, w) => cut(g, (q) => { for (let y = y0, k = 0; y < y1 + s; y += s / 2, k++) for (let x = x0 + ((k % 2) * s) / 2; x < x1 + s; x += s) { const h = s / 2 - w; poly(q, [[x, y - h * 0.9], [x + h, y], [x, y + h * 0.9], [x - h, y]]); } }, "nonzero");
      const coin = (g, x, y, r) => cut(g, (q) => { q.moveTo(x + r, y); q.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7); q.rect(x - r * 0.38, y - r * 0.38, r * 0.76, r * 0.76); });
